description: Monthly is a personal budgeting app for people in Latin America. Connect it to see your month at a glance, break spending down by category, compare months, forecast month end, and log expenses and income.

interface.longDescription: Monthly is a personal budgeting app for people in Latin America. Connect it to see your month at a glance (income, fixed and daily expenses, available balance), break spending down by category, compare months, forecast month end and review upcoming commitments such as unpaid fixed expenses and installments. You can also log expenses and income, pay fixed expenses (including partial payments), record weekend spending, manage savings goals and installment plans, and undo the last change. Every change returns the updated balance and the full list of payments or expenses already recorded, so answers stay accurate without a second lookup. Data stays in your own Monthly account; you can disconnect at any time from Settings.
defaultPrompt: How much do I have left this month?
Break down my spending by category last month
Add a 4500 coffee expense for today

positive.description: Remaining budget for the current month
positive.prompt: How much do I have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the month overview with income, fixed and daily expenses and available balance.

positive.description: Spending by category for last month
positive.prompt: Break down my spending by category last month
positive.expected_behavior: Returns last month expenses grouped by category with amounts and percentages.

positive.prompt: Add a 4500 coffee expense for today
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a 4500 expense dated today and returns a change receipt with an undo id.

positive.description: Log a weekend expense against a reserve that already has expenses
positive.prompt: Add a 10000 expense for gas to my first November weekend reserve
positive.expected_behavior: Records the expense and replies with the reserve budget, total spent, remaining balance and every expense recorded in that reserve, including the earlier ones.

positive.prompt: Compare this month with last month and tell me where I spend more
positive.expected_behavior: Compares both months and highlights the categories with the largest increase.
Reverts the most recent change and confirms what was undone.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Buenos Aires today?
Write a poem about the ocean.

negative.description: Moving real money is out of scope; Monthly only records budget data
negative.prompt: Transfer 50000 pesos to my bank account.

es-AR.subtitle: Tu presupuesto mensual
es-AR.description: Monthly es una app de presupuesto personal. Conectala para ver tu mes de un vistazo (ingresos, gastos fijos y diarios, disponible), desglosar gastos por categoría, comparar meses, proyectar el cierre del mes y revisar próximos compromisos como gastos fijos impagos y cuotas. También podés cargar gastos e ingresos, pagar gastos fijos (incluso en pagos parciales), registrar gastos de fin de semana, administrar metas de ahorro y planes de cuotas, y deshacer el último cambio. Cada cambio devuelve el saldo actualizado y la lista completa de pagos o gastos ya cargados, para que las respuestas sean exactas sin otra consulta. Tus datos quedan en tu cuenta de Monthly y podés desconectarla cuando quieras desde Ajustes.
